exposure: Maternal self-isolation status due to Omicron COVID-19
outcome: Apgar scores (5-min Apgar score specifically reported)
Respiratory support required until 12 h after childbirth
cohort: The study enrolled 127 full-term neonates (16 born to mothers with Omicron COVID-19 history and 99 to non-infectious mothers) who visited a single center between December 2021 and April 2022.
finding: Newborns born to mothers with Omicron COVID-19 during the third trimester had lower birth weight, lower 5-min Apgar scores, and a higher requirement for respiratory support up to 12 hours after birth, especially if their mothers met self-isolation criteria.
followup_time: 12 hours after birth (for respiratory support requirement)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2.958 kg for newborns of infected mothers and 3.064 kg for newborns of non-infected mothers.
